units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 11:3">Snh. XI, 3</cite> <he>להוֹסִיף על דברי וכ׳</he> thus adding to the words of the Scribes (against <cite ref="Deuteronomy 4:2">Deut. IV, 2</cite>). Ib. 88ᵇ <he>ויש בו להו׳</he> when there is a possibility to add. Ib. <he>ואם ה׳ גורע</he> and if he did add, he diminishes (violates the law). Ib. 29ᵃ <he>המוֹסִיף</he>, v. <cite ref="C01379"><he>גָּרַע</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:17">Tosef. Sabb. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:17">VII</cite>), 17 <he>והאומר הוֹסִיפוּ על השולחן</he> (not <he>ואומר</he>) and who (from superstition) says, Add (put one more) to the table; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 559:2">Yalk. Lev. 559</cite> <he>מוֹסַפְנִי על וכ׳</he> (Sifra Metsora beg. <he>מוסיף אני</he>) I will add to what thou saidst.

senses.gloss: , Hithpa. הִתּוֹסַף to be added; to be added to, increase, wax. Mekh. Bo. s. 16; Yalk. Ex. 217 והשני נ׳ לו and the second name was added to the first (without abrogating the first).
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 7">Ex. R. s. 7</cite>, beg. <he>נ׳ לו עוד וכ׳</he> two additional years (of imprisonment) were given him.

<cite ref="Shabbat 152a">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> <he>ת״ח</he> … <he>חכמתן מִתּוֹסֶפֶת עליהן</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>חכמה נִיתּוֹסֶפֶת בהן</he>) when scholars grow old, their wisdom grows with their age; <cite ref="Shabbat 152a">ib.</cite> <he>טפשותן מתוספת וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="I00685"><he>טִפְּשׁוּת</he></cite>.
